'''Dalandae''' was a celestial body<ref name="EGTW" /> located in the [[Dalandae system/Legends|Dalandae system]] of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[John D. Branon/Legends|John D. Branon]] [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from Dalandae.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dalandae was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="EGTW" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Dalandae [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body itself, in grid square M-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
